nodes.description: Public token name string 'MaxWellToken'.
Public token symbol string 'MWT'.
Public decimals value, fixed to 18, used in supply scaling.
Total token supply, set once in constructor from initialSupply.
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer/transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, mutated by approve/transferFrom.
Internal pure multiplication with assert-based overflow check.
Internal pure division helper.
Internal pure subtraction with assert(b <= a) underflow guard.
Internal pure addition with assert(c >= a) overflow guard.
Constructor minting initialSupply * 10**decimals to msg.sender using raw arithmetic.
View function returning balances[_owner].
Transfers _value from msg.sender to _to using SafeMath sub/add.
Transfers _value from _from to _to, checking and reducing allowance of msg.sender.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value with no zero-address or race protection.
View function returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
Caller-controlled address used as balance key, allowance owner and minter.
Raw unchecked multiplication/exponentiation initialSupply * 10 ** uint256(decimals) in constructor.
Product c = a * b inside SafeMath.mul, guarded by assert(c / a == b).
Subtraction a - b inside SafeMath.sub, guarded by assert(b <= a).
Addition c = a + b inside SafeMath.add, guarded by assert(c >= a).
Constructor argument supplying the pre-decimal token amount.
Recipient address of transfer, checked against address(0).
Amount moved in transfer, bounded by sender balance.
Debited owner address in transferFrom.
Credited recipient address in transferFrom.
Amount moved in transferFrom, bounded by balance and allowance.
Address receiving the allowance in approve.
Allowance amount stored for the spender in approve.
Address queried in balanceOf.
Owner address queried in allowance.
Spender address queried in allowance.
First multiplicand of SafeMath.mul.
Second multiplicand of SafeMath.mul.
Local product c in SafeMath.mul returned to caller.
Dividend of SafeMath.div.
Divisor of SafeMath.div.
Local quotient c in SafeMath.div.
Minuend of SafeMath.sub.
Subtrahend of SafeMath.sub, asserted <= a.
First addend of SafeMath.add.
Second addend of SafeMath.add.
Local sum c in SafeMath.add returned to caller.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the mapping key to credit balances in the constructor and to debit/credit in transfer.
msg.sender selects the allowance owner slot in approve and the spender slot check in transferFrom, so caller identity governs allowance writes.
initialSupply feeds the unchecked multiplication/exponentiation computing the minted amount.
initialSupply (scaled) is assigned to totalSupply in the constructor.
Result of the raw arithmetic expression is written directly into totalSupply without SafeMath.
decimals scales the exponent 10 ** uint256(decimals) in the raw constructor arithmetic.
_to is the recipient key credited in balances during transfer.
_value is passed as the argument to SafeMath.sub when debiting the sender in transfer.
_from indexes the balances mapping that is debited in transferFrom.
_from indexes the outer key of the allowed mapping checked in transferFrom.
_to is the recipient key credited in balances during transferFrom.
_value is passed to SafeMath.sub when debiting balances[_from] in transferFrom.
_value is passed to SafeMath.add when crediting balances[_to] in transferFrom.
_spender is the inner key written in allowed[msg.sender][_spender] by approve.
_value is stored as the allowance amount in approve.
_owner is the lookup key read from balances in balanceOf.
_owner is the outer key read from allowed in allowance.
_spender is the inner key read from allowed in allowance.
Operand a feeds the product a * b in SafeMath.mul.
Operand b feeds the product a * b in SafeMath.mul.
Result of a * b is stored in local c and returned by SafeMath.mul.
Dividend a is consumed by SafeMath.div.
Divisor b is consumed by SafeMath.div.
Quotient computed in SafeMath.div is stored in local c and returned.
Minuend a feeds the subtraction a - b in SafeMath.sub.
Subtrahend b feeds the subtraction a - b in SafeMath.sub and is bounded by assert(b <= a).
Addend a feeds the addition a + b in SafeMath.add.
Addend b feeds the addition a + b in SafeMath.add.
Result of a + b is stored in local c and returned by SafeMath.add.
Constructor execution reaches the raw initialSupply * 10 ** decimals multiplication before assigning totalSupply.
transfer invokes SafeMath.sub on the sender balance.
transfer invokes SafeMath.add on the recipient balance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.sub on balances[_from] and on the allowance.
transferFrom invokes SafeMath.add on balances[_to].
SafeMath.mul execution performs the guarded product a * b.
SafeMath.sub execution performs the guarded subtraction a - b.
SafeMath.add execution performs the guarded addition a + b.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor argument has no independent behavior and is fully absorbed into the constructor's minting logic.
Recipient parameter only exists as an argument of transfer and should be folded into it.
Transfer amount parameter is only meaningful inside transfer's balance update.
Debited owner parameter is used solely by transferFrom.
Credited recipient parameter is only used by transferFrom.
Amount parameter has no behavior outside transferFrom's allowance and balance updates.
Spender parameter is consumed only by the approve allowance write.
Allowance value parameter exists only inside approve.
Queried address is a pure read input of balanceOf.
Owner parameter is a pure read input of allowance.
Spender parameter is a pure read input of allowance.
Operand belongs exclusively to the multiplication helper.
Operand belongs exclusively to the multiplication helper.
Local product is the direct result of the a * b unsafe operation and should merge into it.
Dividend is only used inside the division helper.
Divisor is only used inside the division helper.
Local quotient has no independent semantics beyond the division helper.
Minuend is only used inside the subtraction helper.
Subtrahend is only used inside the subtraction helper.
Addend is only used inside the addition helper.
Addend is only used inside the addition helper.
Local sum is the direct result of the a + b unsafe operation and should merge into it.
